scope: Forward closure of known specification/integration gaps against the existing launch contract; not a claim that every unknown defect is found or runtime is complete.

status_vocabulary.source_gap: Missing source stays unresolved and cannot pass by prose.

decisions.title: Danger can kill companions and destroy the camp
decisions.selected_behavior: Survivors and pets can die; fences, gates and every placed equipment class have finite HP and can be destroyed. Camp coordinates do not grant immunity. Intact defenses and actual defenders create safety. Enemy target priority follows current U3: player/pets/camp are eligible targets and unprovoked survivors are ineligible as direct targets while a valid defender is nearby; a provoking survivor may receive retaliation; both player and eligible defending pets being far enables all characters and destructible camp equipment as targets. Persistent typed salvage preserves contents; account levels and paid entitlements are not silently erased. Offline/background simulation remains paused, with no absence raids.
remaining_evidence_or_tuning: Enemy health/damage/cadence, warning windows and repair duration require owner tuning and repeated-failure playtests.
Prove defender-priority and breached-boundary crossing, return routes and no boundary, distance or retreat reward farming.

decisions.title: Paid companion replacement and equipment recovery
decisions.selected_behavior: Player down retains the prior no-owned-inventory-debit policy and returns to a valid safe recovery anchor with working controls. Companion death tombstones the live instance and requires an ordinary earnable-resource/cash replacement purchase; no free care revival or automatic respawn. A new instance preserves earned companion level/XP/skills and account unlocks, with estate cargo claimed separately once. Repair plots charge material appropriate to asset, tier and missing HP. Fence/gate reconstruction restores purchased tier; other destroyed equipment is rebought at level1 with later upgrades re-earned. Furnace destruction invokes affected-camp blackout and a substantial manually reachable raw recovery bill. The player can recover with no helpers, machines, cash or stock. Preserve the baseline no compulsory hunger, stamina, cold or oxygen maintenance meters. Living-actor care cannot resurrect a tombstoned companion.
remaining_evidence_or_tuning: Freeze health, warning, retreat, ordinary replacement/rebuild bills and actor-specific death/estate/replacement presentation with repeated-loss free-player measurements.
Test all companions dead, repeated failure, living-actor care interruption, reserved payment and full destination; a dead instance cannot be revived by care.

decisions.title: Unlimited logical survivor carrying and complete useful jobs
decisions.selected_behavior: Every survivor uses unlimited logical mixed inventory, matching the player. Visible stacks are aggregated representations with truthful quantities; rendered mesh count is never cargo capacity. An authorized job reserves a bounded bill/target quantity and duration, so unlimited capacity cannot create infinite harvesting, overbuying or never-ending trips. All survivors can perform all ordinary physical task families with reachable suitable equipment; specialization changes preference/efficiency and never blocks baseline competence. Include every plot family, conveyors included, and ordinary earned-cash purchases. No autonomous premium, real-money or entitlement purchase. Current U3 amendment: Every unlocked survivor uses unlimited logical mixed raw/product/ordinary-cash custody like the player. Visible stacks aggregate true quantities. Bounded authorized job quantities, budgets and destinations prevent endless harvesting or overbuying. Survivors harvest, hunt, carry, process/restock, bulk-stock customer counters, collect/deposit all available cash, fund every ordinary plot including conveyors, build/repair, rescue, coordinate, travel and perform authorized combat. Basic competence is not paid; suitable equipment and reachable routes remain prerequisites. No autonomous premium or real-money purchase.
remaining_evidence_or_tuning: Demonstrate early/middle/late mixed-load throughput and large-count storage/save behavior.
Tune trip batch amounts, transfer cadence and optional efficiency upgrades without reducing logical capacity.

decisions.title: Owned roster, living deployments and paid losses
decisions.selected_behavior: All seven pet species remain permanently unlockable; their live instances can die and require ordinary paid replacement. All seven attack. Select up to three pets for a field expedition; reserve pets receive useful eligible safe-camp/local assignments and retain combat roles in suitable areas. When no eligible safe job exists, a truthful ready/rest state is valid; guarding an empty area without actual protection value does not count as a completed useful job. Select up to two survivors as field escorts from the working population; this expedition limit does not cap separately assigned local workers. Camp survivors remain useful in their assigned jobs; no device-specific logical worker cap or paid active slot is introduced. Switching at a safe camp is free and first settles cargo/jobs; injury, attack recovery and cooldown state persist, so switching cannot heal or reset attacks. Offscreen active-session work uses the same conserved job ledger; unseen combat never fabricates kills or loot. All owned workers are represented by the authored rescue/content roster, rather than unlimited procedural spawning. Current U3 amendment: All seven species remain available through ordinary progression and all seven attack plus perform a useful specialty. Keep the selected starting expedition of up to three pets and two survivor escorts; local workers are separate. Ownership/unlock and a live deployed instance are distinct: a dead, undeployed or absent roster entry cannot defend a camp. Assign eligible living reserve companions useful local work or defense; honest ready/rest is valid when no job exists. Free team switching does not revive a dead instance, move estate cargo, heal damage or reset attack recovery. Paid replacement is the only return from companion death.
remaining_evidence_or_tuning: Three pets/two escorts are initial authored design limits, not measured performance claims; prove the exact busy-scene population.
T31/T56 must bind the actual authored per-region survivor census and test every active assignment, including offscreen-to-visible handoff.

decisions.title: Simple assignments with coherent threat and job decisions
decisions.selected_behavior: Use one contextual goal/assignment choice, one recall/return choice and optional priority selection. Default priority is explicit recall/safety, immediate threat to the protected actor/area, authorized selected hostile, assigned defense/hunt, then safe opportunistic attack. Keep valid work/targets stable, reserve approach space and resources, and release stale claims. Worker spending is limited to an approved goal, ordinary resource/cash budget and protected reserve; a changed target generation, invalid acquisition path or revoked budget stops before the next debit with a clear reason; accepted quote amounts cannot silently change. T07 remains the frozen human-context selector; pet/job arbitration belongs to the species/T31 owners and does not silently extend T07 scope. Current U3 amendment: Use contextual goal/assignment, recall and useful priorities. Survivors may initiate assigned hunts or attacks under latest U3; the earlier self-defense-only restriction is withdrawn. Identity and explicit huntability prevent attacking owned pets/customers. Enemies use stable reachable target priority, per-enemy provocation and saved distance hysteresis. Preserve reservations, authorized ordinary budgets and clear blocked reasons. Bulk counter service belongs to customer pickup plus player/unlocked-survivor stocking/cash jobs, never an auto-spawned attendant. T07 human-context scope remains preserved; species/job owners implement their own arbitration.
remaining_evidence_or_tuning: Test blocked route, depletion, full storage, budget revocation, simultaneous last plot payment, recall and resumption with bounded retry.
Measure decision cost and useful job completion; navigation avoidance alone is not intelligence.

decisions.title: Bounded combat roster and contextual weapon progression
decisions.selected_behavior: The selected core combat families are a pursuing hostile wolf, a close raider, a visibly telegraphed heavy ice brute, a ranged rival rifleman, a lane-pressure hooded swarmer and a hooded siege boss that combines readable established threats. Use their existing selected GitHub sheets. These six define the launch behavioral roster; regional art variants must keep explicit identity/source and habitat compatibility, not make a polar animal live in lava. Select the Tundra Stag as the authored hunt source and preserve current hostile-wolf meat drops; owned pets are never prey. Boar and other additional wildlife concepts remain reserve. Other enemy and meat render concepts remain preserved reserve, not mandatory encounters or currencies. Player weapons have two contextual families: the existing axe for close work/defense and an authored spear for longer-reach defense, earned at the Level9 defense goal. Free earned-material tiers improve each; no action bar, compulsory ammo wallet or paid-only counter. The axe sheet is direct reference; the existing spear-raider gear sheet is a proportion starting point, not an approved player rig or motion.
remaining_evidence_or_tuning: Bind exact hostile/hunt IDs, habitats, unlock rows, HP/damage, contact profiles and useful counterplay.
Create and review any missing player spear and regional variant native assets against the selected references; no static render grants animation approval.
Every biome uses only habitat-appropriate selected encounters or explicitly reviewed variants; new archetypes require a scoped decision rather than automatic concept activation.

decisions.title: Physical regional continuity
decisions.selected_behavior: Keep the same move, gather, visibly carry, deliver, transform, rescue and defend loop across ten connected regions. Underwater work uses protected dry habitats/tunnels and authored accessible work sites; the owl remains on suitable air routes/staging. Sky play uses walkable connected platforms/bridges; quadrupeds do not fly. Volcanic and swamp areas use restored safe lanes and appropriate reachable work surfaces. Every species retains useful combat in applicable regions and useful safe work when a region is unsuitable. Travel preserves identity/cargo/jobs and offers a free return to the last safe restored camp. Regional art never implies a new oxygen/heat/poison maintenance meter. Playable underwater travel and work remain on dry protected routes/positions; appropriate gear reaches salvage without mandatory swimming. Each earlier region owner implements its own local arrival/return contract before its integration; T53 later integrates shared transport and is not an added backward prerequisite. Camp return is revalidated against actual destruction/raid state; choose a valid recovery anchor rather than teleport into a destroyed unsafe site. A pet on safe staging is still a real damageable actor, with eligibility and evacuation appropriate to that location.
remaining_evidence_or_tuning: Prove actual routes, terrain contact, target reach, transport and no stranding in each region.
The regional outcome matrix selects content; missing native assets and motion remain unproved.

decisions.title: Purposeful materials and dynamic reachable economy
decisions.selected_behavior: Adopt the dated progression/economy value-chain decisions as the forward selected design. Coal is an earned physical fuel input, metal is ore feedstock, and steel is a processed material; slate, planks and blocks have named construction uses. Existing money is the single ordinary earned currency regardless of till/pocket/house custody. Use Gems as the display name for the one primary premium currency, canonical premium_gems, with explicit migration if an existing selected runtime wallet uses another ID; do not create a second wallet. XP is progression and VIP is a permanent entitlement. Launch events grant existing resources, money and explicit rewards; no event token wallet. Rendered containers and meat variants do not automatically create new inventory/currency IDs. Unselected concepts remain preserved reserve. Current U3 amendment: Retain the selected physical raw/product value chains and one ordinary Cash wallet (money) with distinct custody locations; one optional premium Gems wallet (premium_gems), XP progression and permanent VIP entitlement. Customer baskets combine explicitly processed products from operating sources or constructively reachable purchasable/rebuildable plots. Plot/upgrade material mix and quantity depend on authored progression and target tier. Prove complete source/recipe/quantity/bill dependencies without unearned order payout or circular self-funding. Persist accepted quotes and contributions; re-evaluate reachability after destruction. Cash spending includes committed outflow so derived receipts cannot recreate spent money. Launch events add no new token wallet.
remaining_evidence_or_tuning: Bind recipe quantities, prices, rates, identifiers and migration to actual producer code before integration.
Run free-player reachable progression, surplus/shortage and conversion-cycle tests; no claims of numeric balance from this plan.

decisions.title: Active-world continuity and paused absence
decisions.selected_behavior: Launch ordinary world simulation pauses when the app backgrounds or closes. Resume the saved state without absence damage, missing cargo or invented offline income. Offscreen work may continue only while the game is active and the same authoritative job ledger advances. Local played time governs ordinary machine/actor animation and recovery. Server time governs live event availability, purchases and entitlements; changing the device clock never creates rewards or extends an event. Core ordinary play and recovery remain usable offline; server-only grants/purchases stay visibly pending or unavailable until verified. No speculative reward replay on reconnect. Launch event objective participation requires verified connection. While offline, the event clearly pauses objective credit and consumes no event-specific inputs; ordinary core activities continue. Until a server completion receipt exists the UI says pending, never earned. A server-verified completion before expiry creates a durable earned claim that remains deliverable after expiry; a lost response or reconnect grants it exactly once. An uncompleted expired objective grants nothing. Current U3 amendment: Ordinary simulation pauses while backgrounded or closed; no absence damage or invented offline income. During active play, rendering distance or region unload cannot despawn logical raids, heal enemies or erase structure/companion damage. Preserve quotes, reservations, encounter budgets, tombstones, target/provocation and typed salvage. Core manual play/recovery remains offline. Server time governs events/purchases; verified earned-before-expiry claims survive expiry and deliver once, while offline event participation pauses visibly without spending event inputs. A destroyed producer or blacked-out camp requires current acquisition revalidation.

decisions.title: A complete Level100 ending within launch scope
decisions.selected_behavior: Author one useful outcome for each Level1–100 within the existing ten bands. Level100 completes the restored connected camp/route network, shows an earned conclusion/celebration and lets the player continue existing production, exploration and launch events. Do not add Level101, new regions, a new mastery-contract system, decoration, co-op or additional Level100 activity families as1.0 blockers. Prior T12 structural role IDs and T10/T11 binding receipts remain intact; new outcome rows are content decisions, not activation or proof. Customer mixes and project/upgrade bills use current constructive reachability and progression rules. Revised outcomes remove automatic staffing and free-damage-restoration assumptions.
remaining_evidence_or_tuning: Freeze attainable costs/rewards and pacing with first-time and returning free-player sessions.

decisions.title: Fair losses, transparent purchases and feasible events
decisions.selected_behavior: Keep the existing FirstThaw/weekly/seasonal frameworks and pre-approved components. Events are optional and cannot be required to repair a base-game shortage or recover a companion. Reject schedules with unavailable resources, locations, companions or time; use server-time expiry, exactly-once grants, kill switch and rollback. Preserve permanent transparent VIP, advertised purchase value, verified restoration and a realistic$0 Level1–100 route. Challenge difficulty never reads spending. Diagnostics observe stuck jobs, missing transfers, save conflicts and performance without becoming gameplay authority or collecting unnecessary personal information. Earned but unclaimed event rewards survive expiry when a completion receipt was committed before expiry. Network interruption between that receipt and grant is resolved by the same durable claim key, not by current event visibility. Current U3 amendment: Companion replacement and damaged-camp recovery are meaningful ordinary-resource/cash costs within a measured $0 Level1–100 route. A previously purchased permanent entitlement is not charged again merely because an instance died. Challenge and price generation never read paid history/VIP or punish current wealth. Existing optional launch events require attainable sources and pause/cancel safely when their required site is unavailable; they cannot be the only recovery path. Preserve verified grants, kill switch/rollback and minimal-purpose diagnostics. No forced revive sale, ad, energy meter or compulsory wait is introduced.
remaining_evidence_or_tuning: Run actual purchase restore/refund/reconnect, expired events, disabled server components, diagnostics failure and privacy/security cases.

requirements.title: Stakes, sanctuary and recoverable actors
requirements.selected_action: Preserve account unlocks, player-owned inventory and earned progression while exposing actors and placed camp equipment to warned, real damage. Companions can die and require ordinary paid replacement; damaged structures require paid material repairs, and destroyed equipment restarts at level1. Camp safety comes from actual defenders and intact defenses, not coordinate immunity. Recovery remains constructively attainable without real-money payment. Current U3 additions: While the player or an eligible living defending pet is within the camp's defense range, enemies target eligible reachable player/pet/camp objectives. An unprovoked survivor is ineligible as a direct target, including when every preferred target is absent or blocked. Seek a valid approach or blocking defense instead. An enemy may directly retaliate against the survivor that attacks it; both player and eligible defending pets being far permits unrestricted targets. This does not grant collateral damage immunity: an actual valid contact can still hurt a survivor. When both player and defending pets are beyond the warned defense boundary, hostile encounter policy permits all characters and destructible camp structures as targets. Hysteresis stabilizes the boundary. Distance-based rendering or region unloading cannot delete the logical encounter, heal enemies or fabricate offscreen loot. Ordinary simulation pauses while backgrounded/closed. Fences and gates have substantial authored HP but can be breached. Every placed camp/field equipment class has HP and damaged/destroyed states. Breaches change collision and pathing at the actual commit. Interior safety comes from intact defenses, defenders and enemy behavior; standing inside camp is not permanent invulnerability. Repair plots quote materials appropriate to asset/tier and missing HP. A repair job has a fixed authorized HP/material budget; new damage cannot be erased for free. Fence/gate ruins may be reconstructed through the repair plot at their purchased tier. Uncommitted escrow returns safely when the asset generation changes. Non-boundary equipment at zero HP becomes a ruin. Rebuy through the appropriate plot using a new generation and level 1 equipment. Account progression and known recipes remain unlocked, but lost equipment upgrades must be purchased again. Persist destruction; cancel/refund only uncommitted work, not already consumed production or repairs. Pets and survivors can die. Death tombstones the live instance, cancels its attacks/jobs/reservations and requires an ordinary earnable-resource/cash replacement purchase. A new instance is created once; preserve earned companion level/XP/skills, account unlocks and permanent paid entitlements because the user only required equipment level resets. No free care revival or automatic respawn. Furnace destruction puts that camp into blackout: pause automated production, new customer admission and ordinary non-recovery worker jobs; preserve already committed value. Rebuild the furnace at level1 with a substantial progression/lost-tier raw-material bill, then re-earn upgrades. Manual gathering, recovery jobs, salvage/cash collection, combat and construction remain possible. Retain permanent baseline player gathering capability and a reachable renewable manual wood/stone path. Recovery bills cannot require a destroyed producer, new customer payout, premium purchase or companion. A finite saved siege objective/attack budget ends in retreat after core defeat without a victory reward; scheduled new camp raids pause through reconstruction, while roaming threats remain real. Scheduled raids require a full five-minute (300 active seconds) warning naming the threatened camp, with a saved 5:00 countdown, sound and equivalent muted cue; no scheduled-raid damage occurs before it expires. If admission is due while ineligible, wait and then give the full warning. This does not cancel real roaming threats.

Ownership, live-instance mortality, deployment and injury are separate states. Current U3 additions: Player and unlocked survivors share unlimited logical mixed raw, processed and ordinary-money custody. A worker can bulk collect cash and deposit it at a valid destination. Useful job amounts and destinations bound work; rendered pile count is not capacity. While the player or an eligible living defending pet is within the camp's defense range, enemies target eligible reachable player/pet/camp objectives. An unprovoked survivor is ineligible as a direct target, including when every preferred target is absent or blocked. Seek a valid approach or blocking defense instead. An enemy may directly retaliate against the survivor that attacks it; both player and eligible defending pets being far permits unrestricted targets. This does not grant collateral damage immunity: an actual valid contact can still hurt a survivor. When both player and defending pets are beyond the warned defense boundary, hostile encounter policy permits all characters and destructible camp structures as targets. Hysteresis stabilizes the boundary. Distance-based rendering or region unloading cannot delete the logical encounter, heal enemies or fabricate offscreen loot. Ordinary simulation pauses while backgrounded/closed. Pets and survivors can die. Death tombstones the live instance, cancels its attacks/jobs/reservations and requires an ordinary earnable-resource/cash replacement purchase. A new instance is created once; preserve earned companion level/XP/skills, account unlocks and permanent paid entitlements because the user only required equipment level resets. No free care revival or automatic respawn. Scheduled raids require a full five-minute (300 active seconds) warning naming the threatened camp, with a saved 5:00 countdown, sound and equivalent muted cue; no scheduled-raid damage occurs before it expires. If admission is due while ineligible, wait and then give the full warning. This does not cancel real roaming threats.
